name: Europe
description: Follow Europe, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Evidence of bird strike after man nearly sucked out of plane window, NTSB says
changes.summary: A bird strike may have been the cause of an incident in which a passenger was nearly sucked out of a broken window aboard a Ryanair flight in Europe last month, the NTSB found.

changes.title: EU cities plan to compensate for a fifth of their emissions through carbon removal, but few have thought through how
changes.summary: An analysis of 103 European cities' climate-neutral plans for 2030 (including 22 capital cities) shows that municipalities are planning to rely on carbon removal to compensate for about a fifth of their emissions. This would mean removing roughly 61 million tonnes of emissions from the atmosphere—close to Austria's ann.

changes.title: From Europe to Asia, floods to heatwaves, world experiences weather shocks
changes.summary: At least eight people died in Japan as heavy rains flooded roads and disrupted traffic while firefighters from Britain to France and Croatia struggled to contain blazes in Europe's fifth heatwave this summer (Image credit: PHILIP FONG).

changes.title: More Wildfires and Extreme Heat Roil Europe, but Relief Is on the Horizon
changes.summary: Another day of near record heat baked the continent on Friday, but temperatures could retreat to seasonal averages in the coming days.

changes.title: As Europe Gets Hotter, Its Transportation Systems Struggle to Cope
changes.summary: The continent’s railways and roads “were engineered for a climate that no longer exists,” one expert said.

changes.title: Another Day of Extreme Heat Bakes Europe, but Relief Is on the Horizon
changes.summary: Friday is delivering another day of near record heat to the continent, but toward the end of the weekend temperatures could retreat to seasonal averages.

changes.title: UK records hottest day of the year as western Europe swelters once again
changes.summary: Britain, like France, is experiencing its fifth heat wave of the year, with the first recorded in May.

changes.title: Total solar eclipse dipped parts of Europe into complete darkness. Here's what they saw.
changes.summary: A total solar eclipse brought darkness to parts of Europe, the only time the phenomenon will be visible to humans in 2026. CBS News' Rob Marciano has more on the stunning moments.

changes.title: Views of the total solar eclipse from parts of Europe
changes.summary: A total solar eclipse was visible in parts of Europe for the first time since 1912. Rob Marciano reports.

changes.title: The Most Spectacular Photos of Europe's Total Solar Eclipse
changes.summary: People jumping from the diving platform at Kolovare Beach in Zadar, Croatia during the total solar eclipse, August 12, 2026 —Zvonimir Barisin—PIXSELL/Sipa USA/Reuters On Aug. 12, the luckiest 15 million people in the world were those living in a narrow band measuring approximately 5,100 miles long and 180 miles wide ,.
